name: Bidder's Choice
summary: A sequential auction for heterogeneous goods where the top bidder each round chooses one remaining item to win.
rules_text: There is a set of distinct objects for sale and a group of bidders, each with private valuations for each object. The game lasts for as many rounds as there are objects. In each round, every remaining bidder submits a sealed bid. The highest bidder wins the round and pays his bid amount, then selects one object from those still available to take. That object is removed from the pool. All other bidders pay nothing that round and remain for the next round. The next round proceeds with the remaining objects, repeating the bidding and selection. A bidder may win multiple rounds. A player's total payoff is the sum of values of objects he selected minus the sum of bids he paid when winning.
rating_reason: Heterogeneous multiunit auction with sequential bids and selection, fully implementable.
